title: Founder Authorization Instruction Gate
summary: Turns a v3.3.9 review-ready packet into one controlled founder question while keeping founder grant, authorization, execution, storage writes, canonical writes, public release, and production disabled.

instruction_checks.rule: The instruction gate can start only from a v3.3.9 ready authorization review object whose route is Ready for founder instruction.
Founder instruction readiness can be recorded, but founder grant and authorization remain false.
The same review gate, authorization draft, founder decision, source answer, source record, and source family must stay locked.
Execution, storage, canonical writes, public release, production, accounts, secrets, and migrations remain blocked.
The next step is a controlled permission preflight, not a runnable instruction.
The instruction expires on review, draft, source, rights, reviewer, rollback, monitoring, packet, or code change.

question_contract.label: One question
question_contract.rule: Ask whether this exact reviewed packet should move to permission preflight.

question_contract.label: No grant
question_contract.rule: The question must not grant authorization, execution, storage, release, or production.

question_contract.label: Source locked
question_contract.rule: The review gate, draft, source answer, source record, and source family remain visible.

question_contract.label: False flags
question_contract.rule: Every operational authority flag remains false in the packet.
